        '1.0 mega'

        ("mega", 6),
        ("kilo", 3),
    ]
    try:
        value = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return value

        return str(value)

        if abs(value) >= 10 ** power:
            chopped = value / (10 ** power)
            return f"{format % chopped} {prefix}"
    return str(value)
```
